intro.text: A Veden servant of the assassin Liss.

items.text: Talak had replaced Liss's previous servant, a Shin man she found unsettling. He guarded the door when Jasnah Kholin met Liss to arrange surveillance of Queen Aesudan.

appearance.text: Brutish-looking, with a speck of red in his beard that hints at Unkalaki blood.
